verdict.rationale: Airweave's evidence describes syncing structured data from apps/databases and searching via vector/agentic search, but there is no mention of uploading or storing raw files (images, PDFs) as direct memory inputs, nor any OCR/image-parsing capability for later recall. The connectors sync existing SaaS/app data (Slack, Drive, Notion, etc.) rather than accepting arbitrary file uploads as memory. Missing for 10: file/image upload API, PDF/image parsing or OCR pipeline, evidence of recalling content from such files.
